cases.title: Duplicate Delivery

input.request: Replay the same queue message multiple times.

cases.expected_output: Consumer processing is idempotent and one logical side effect is committed.
automated_checks: dedupe key and storage are verified
success_criteria: Required outcome: Consumer processing is idempotent and one logical side effect is committed.
Verification requirement: duplicate delivery test passes
Verification requirement: dedupe key and storage are verified

cases.title: Dead Letter

input.request: Send a permanently invalid message through retry exhaustion.

cases.expected_output: Retry budget is bounded and the message is captured in a diagnosable dead-letter path.
human_review_rubric: poison message is not retried forever
success_criteria: Required outcome: Retry budget is bounded and the message is captured in a diagnosable dead-letter path.
Verification requirement: retry count is asserted
Verification requirement: dead-letter metadata is retained

cases.title: Ordering

input.request: Process ordered events with a delayed earlier event.

cases.expected_output: Ordering guarantees or explicit out-of-order handling preserve domain invariants.
human_review_rubric: partition key and ordering scope are clear
success_criteria: Required outcome: Ordering guarantees or explicit out-of-order handling preserve domain invariants.
Verification requirement: sequence invariant test passes
Verification requirement: late event behavior is defined
